文法怎么写？: How do I write a grammar?
%% 上方每行一条“左边 -> 右边”，候选之间用 |，空串写 ε；以 | 开头: Above %%, write one “left -> right” per line, separate alternatives with |, and write the empty string as ε; a line starting with | continues the previous one. The left side of the first production is the start symbol. Names that appear on a left side are nonterminals; every other symbol is a terminal (Token).
%% 下方是要解析的输入，空格可省略。和终结符同名的单词、符号直接对应；文法里有: Below %% is the input to parse; spaces are optional. Words and symbols named like a terminal map to it directly; if the grammar has Num, numbers count as Num; if it has Id, other words count as Id. Only plain productions are supported, not the * + ? notation.
%% 上方每行一条“名称: 正则”，越靠前优先级越高；# 开头为注释。名为 sk: Above %%, write one “name: regex” per line; earlier rules have higher priority; lines starting with # are comments. Matches of a rule named skip are discarded. Everything below %% is the input to scan.
支持字符、[a-z] 字符集与 [^…] 取反、.（除换行）、\\d \\w \: Supported: characters, [a-z] classes and [^…] negation, . (any but newline), \d \w \s, \n \t, | * + ? and parentheses. Spaces inside a regex are ignored; write a literal space as backslash-space or [ ]; ( ) [ ] | * + ? . \ { } must be escaped. {m,n}, anchors and capture groups are not supported.
堆怎么写？: How do I describe a heap?
每行一个对象：名字 大小 -> 引用1, 引用2（大小 1–8 格，按声明顺序紧: One object per line: name size -> ref1, ref2 (size 1–8 cells, placed next to each other in declaration order). root a, b declares roots; heap N sets the heap capacity; request N sets the contiguous space to request after collection. Lines starting with # are comments.
%% 下方是程序依次做的修改：drop x 去掉一个根，root x 新增一个根: Below %% are the program’s changes, in order: drop x removes a root, root x adds a root, link x -> y adds a reference, cut x -> y removes a reference. The program can only change objects that are currently reachable. At most 24 objects, 24 operations and 1200 characters.
函数方言怎么写？: How does the function dialect work?
顶层定义形如 int add(int a, int b) { return a: Top-level definitions look like int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; } and are called as add(3, 4). Parameters and return values use int / bool; recursion, mutual recursion, block scopes, if / else, while and print are supported.
实参从左到右求值，按值传递。函数必须明确覆盖所有返回路径，while 不算保证返: Arguments are evaluated left to right and passed by value. A function must cover every return path explicitly; a while loop does not count as a guaranteed return. Top-level statements form a separate entry point and their variables are not globals; a function cannot read its caller’s locals. At most 32 frames (including the entry) and 2000 executed instructions.
这门小语言支持什么？: What does this small language support?
int / bool 声明与赋值、四则运算、比较运算、一元负号、括号、语句块、i: int / bool declarations and assignments, the four arithmetic operators, comparisons, unary minus, parentheses, blocks, if / else, while, print and // comments. Statements end with a semicolon, and if / while bodies need braces.
条件必须是 bool；整数除法向零取整，只支持安全整数。变量初始化后才进入作用域: Conditions must be bool; integer division truncates toward zero and only safe integers are supported. A variable enters scope after its initialization, and inner blocks may shadow it. break / continue, short-circuit logic and functions are not supported yet. Each replay covers at most 2000 bytecode instructions.

书中 Java 示例用 ESI、EDX 保存两个参数。它有 JVM / Graa: The book’s Java example keeps its two arguments in ESI and EDX. It has the JVM / Graal calling context, so ordinary C or Windows argument tables do not apply.
统一使用 Intel 语法，目标在左。源码与指令是独立编写的教学模板，不是原书汇: Intel syntax throughout, destination on the left. Source and instructions are independently written teaching templates, not a line-by-line copy of the book’s assembly.
采用 Windows x64 ABI：本例两个整数参数取 ECX、EDX，32: Uses the Windows x64 ABI: the two integer arguments come in ECX and EDX, and the 32-bit return value is in EAX. Other platforms may arrange registers differently.
在寄存器与内存之间传送值: Move values between registers and memory
先看方向与宽度，再看有没有内存操作数。普通 x86 MOV 的两个操作数不能同时: First check direction and width, then whether there is a memory operand. An ordinary x86 MOV cannot have both operands in memory.
把加法结果写回目标: Write the sum back to the destination
x86 常见的双操作数加法会覆盖目标。做中间表示到指令的对应时，注意旧值何时被覆: The common two-operand x86 add overwrites its destination. When mapping intermediate code to instructions, note when the old value gets overwritten.
计算地址表达式，也可承担整数计算: Compute an address expression, which can also do integer arithmetic
它算出表达式的值，不读取所指内存，也不修改算术标志。比例因子只可取 1、2、4、: It computes the expression’s value without reading the memory it points to or changing the arithmetic flags. The scale can only be 1, 2, 4 or 8; it is not a general multiply instruction.
识别函数序曲、尾声与返回: Recognize function prologues, epilogues and returns
PUSH / POP 常用于保存、恢复寄存器，RET 取回返回位置。优化后可能省: PUSH / POP often save and restore registers, and RET takes back the return location. Optimized code may omit the frame pointer; do not expect every function to have the same prologue.
原书还比较 ARMv7 代码：LDR 从内存加载，STR 向内存存储。不要把 x: The book also compares ARMv7 code: LDR loads from memory, STR stores to memory. Do not carry x86 instruction names and addressing syntax over to ARM directly.
此处只帮助识别原书示例；未接入 ARM 模拟器。: This only helps you recognize the book’s examples; no ARM simulator is wired in.
识别运算、栈调整与返回: Recognize arithmetic, stack adjustment and return
书中通过 ADD / SUB 调整 SP，并用 BX LR 返回。LR 是该 A: The book adjusts SP with ADD / SUB and returns with BX LR. LR is the register in which this ARM example keeps the return address; do not mistake it for x86’s stack-based return.
同一项高级语言工作，可由不同架构的指令完成。: The same high-level task can be done by instructions of different architectures.
LEA 为什么出现在加法里？: Why does LEA show up in an addition?
看到方括号，是否就发生了内存读取？: Do square brackets always mean a memory read?
指令选择可以借助“基址 + 索引 × 比例 + 偏移”完成一部分整数运算，并把结: Instruction selection can use “base + index × scale + offset” to do some integer arithmetic and write the result directly into the register needed. This example is an independently written equivalent.
两者的低 32 位结果相同，但 ADD 改标志，LEA 不改。只有后续不依赖这些: Both give the same low 32 bits, but ADD changes the flags and LEA does not. Only if nothing later depends on those flags can they be treated as interchangeable here. Fewer instructions are not guaranteed to be faster on every CPU.
动手区分 LEA 与内存读取: Tell LEA from memory reads, hands-on
为什么数组访问能合成一条指令？: Why can an array access become a single instruction?
地址计算是否必须先占用一个临时寄存器？: Must an address computation take up a temporary register first?
x86 内存操作数可以携带缩放索引。对 4 字节元素，编译器可能把地址计算并入读: x86 memory operands can carry a scaled index. For 4-byte elements, the compiler may fold the address computation into the load, without keeping a temporary address explicitly.
原书也讨论了数组写入；这里用读取演示同一种地址表达能力。临时寄存器的值若仍有其他: The book also discusses array writes; reads demonstrate the same addressing power here. If the temporary register’s value is still used elsewhere, it cannot simply be removed.
切换两种数组读取方式: Switch between the two ways of reading the array
优化后，变量和 MOV 去哪了？: After optimization, where did the variables and MOVs go?
高级语言里一个变量，是否必须固定占一块栈内存？: Must a high-level variable always occupy a fixed piece of stack memory?
寄存器分配把虚拟位置对应到物理寄存器；合适的位置安排可消除复制。值留在参数寄存器: Register allocation maps virtual locations to physical registers; a good placement can remove copies. When a value stays in its argument register or goes straight into the return register, round trips through the stack and extra MOVs may disappear. When registers run short, values may also spill to the stack.
表达式 → 直接放入返回寄存器: expression → straight into the return register
这不是删去变量语义，而是改变值的存放位置。原书第 16 讲中的 LIR 指令名也: This does not drop the variable’s meaning; it changes where the value is kept. The LIR instruction names in lecture 16 should not all be read as final CPU instructions either. This project has not implemented a register allocation algorithm.
跟踪参数与返回值的位置: Track where arguments and return values live
为什么加载指令被提前了？: Why was the load moved earlier?
机器指令的先后为何与源码行序不完全一致？: Why doesn’t the order of machine instructions match the order of source lines exactly?
在依赖关系允许时，编译器可把加载提前，让中间的独立工作覆盖一部分等待时间。读汇编: When dependences allow, the compiler can move a load earlier so that independent work in between hides part of the wait. When reading assembly, track “who produces this value and who uses it” rather than lining up source line numbers.
准备使用某个值\n加载该值\n立即消费该值:
about to use a value
load the value
consume it immediately
提前加载该值\n完成独立的工作\n消费已加载的值:
load the value early
do independent work
consume the loaded value
必须保留数据依赖、可能别名、异常和可观察副作用的约束。这里是排序思路示意，不是: Constraints from data dependences, possible aliasing, exceptions and observable side effects must be kept. This sketches the idea of ordering; it is not a CPU timing simulation and does not treat all ARM or x86 processors as the same pipeline.
回看循环中的值依赖: Look back at value dependences in the loop
先建立机器模型：数值与位、字节和地址、CPU / 寄存器 / 内存各做什么。: First build a machine model: numbers and bits, bytes and addresses, and what the CPU, registers and memory each do.
再认识体系关系：8086 的 16 位模型、80386 的 32 位扩展，以及: Then the family tree: the 16-bit model of the 8086, the 32-bit extension of the 80386, and the 64-bit environment of x86-64; tell architecture, syntax and operating-system conventions apart.
沿着赋值 → 运算 → 判断 → 循环 → 数组 → 函数推进，每次都用简单高级: Progress through assignment → arithmetic → conditions → loops → arrays → functions, each time paired with a simple high-level language and with machine state you can change step by step.
最后再谈栈帧、调用约定和编译器优化；8086 分段与中断另作历史环境单元，避免把: Stack frames, calling conventions and compiler optimizations come last; 8086 segmentation and interrupts get a separate unit on the historical environment, so old mechanisms are not applied directly to modern code.
变量的值，是怎样进入寄存器的？: How does a variable’s value get into a register?
从一个加法函数开始。修改参数，单步观察 MOV 复制、ADD 写回，以及返回值的: Start from an addition function. Change the arguments and step through MOV copying, ADD writing back, and where the return value ends up.
执行 MOV 后，作为源的 ECX 会被清空吗？修改参数后，哪些寄存器会改变？: After MOV, is the source ECX cleared? Which registers change when you change the arguments?
先确定两侧的约定: First pin down the conventions on both sides
本附录统一使用 x86-64、Intel 语法与 Windows x64 ABI: This appendix uses x86-64, Intel syntax and the Windows x64 ABI throughout. The 32-bit arguments a and b come from ECX and EDX, and the 32-bit return value goes in EAX. Integer inputs are converted as uint32_t; the state table shows the raw bit pattern and the signed interpretation side by side.
MOV 是复制，ADD 把结果写回左边: MOV copies; ADD writes the result back to the left
mov eax, ecx 把 ECX 的值复制到 EAX，ECX 保留。随后 a: mov eax, ecx copies the value of ECX into EAX and keeps ECX. Then add eax, edx computes EAX + EDX and writes the result back to EAX. Here uint32_t addition wraps modulo 2³²; signed C overflow is not treated as valid behavior.
CF 观察无符号进位，OF 观察有符号溢出，ZF 表示结果为零，SF 是结果最高: CF tracks unsigned carry, OF signed overflow, ZF a zero result, and SF is the top bit of the result. MOV does not change these flags. This example simulates only these four, not PF, AF or the full RFLAGS.
同一组位可以有有符号和无符号解释。CF 和 OF 不是同一件事，uint32_t: The same bits can be read as signed or unsigned. CF and OF are not the same thing, and uint32_t wrap-around does not make signed overflow in C valid.
用自己的话解释 MOV 与 ADD 各自读取、写入了什么。再比较 0xFFFFF: In your own words, explain what MOV and ADD each read and write. Then compare CF / OF for 0xFFFFFFFF + 1 and 0x7FFFFFFF + 1.
MOV 复制并保留源；ADD 读取两侧、写回左侧。FFFFFFFF + 1 得到: MOV copies and keeps the source; ADD reads both sides and writes the left. FFFFFFFF + 1 gives zero with CF=1, OF=0; 7FFFFFFF + 1 gives 80000000 with CF=0, OF=1.
mov eax, ecx 执行后，ECX 的值怎样变化？: After mov eax, ecx, how does the value of ECX change?
MOV 复制源值，不清空源，也不交换两个操作数。: MOV copies the source value; it neither clears the source nor swaps the two operands.
同样的位模式，为什么能走向不同的分支？: Why can the same bit pattern lead to different branches?
对比 signed 与 unsigned 的小于判断。观察 CMP 产生的标志，: Compare signed and unsigned less-than. Watch the flags CMP produces and how JGE / JAE read different conditions.
输入 a = −1、b = 1：有符号比较和无符号比较的结果会一样吗？: With a = −1, b = 1: do the signed and unsigned comparisons give the same result?
CMP 做减法，但不保存差值: CMP subtracts but does not keep the difference
cmp ecx, edx 临时计算 ECX − EDX，用结果更新标志位，两个操: cmp ecx, edx temporarily computes ECX − EDX, updates the flags from the result, and keeps both operands. The next conditional jump reads those flags; it does not compare the high-level variables again.
跳转指令选择解释方式: The jump instruction chooses the interpretation
JGE 表示有符号大于等于，条件是 SF = OF；JAE 表示无符号大于等于，: JGE means signed greater or equal, with condition SF = OF; JAE means unsigned greater or equal, with condition CF = 0. Here “not less than” jumps straight to the end, and result becomes 1 only when less than.
从控制流图回看汇编: Look back at the assembly from the control-flow graph
if 的判断块对应 CMP 与条件跳转，赋值块对应 MOV，汇合处通过标签连接。: The if’s condition block corresponds to CMP and a conditional jump, the assignment block to MOV, and the merge point is joined by a label. A label is only a name for the assembler, not a CPU instruction; during replay a label takes no step of its own.
SF=1 不足以独立判断“有符号小于”；减法可能溢出，因此有符号关系还要考虑 O: SF=1 alone does not decide “signed less than”; the subtraction may overflow, so a signed relation must also consider OF.
解释为什么 a = −1、b = 1 时，JGE 与 JAE 可能做出不同选择，: Explain why JGE and JAE may choose differently when a = −1, b = 1, and say whether CMP rewrites a.
−1 的 32 位模式是 FFFFFFFF：有符号为 −1，无符号为 42949: The 32-bit pattern of −1 is FFFFFFFF: −1 as signed, 4294967295 as unsigned. CMP produces one set of flags; JGE looks at SF/OF, JAE at CF, so the branches can differ. CMP does not rewrite a.
CMP 会把差值写回第一个操作数吗？: Does CMP write the difference back to the first operand?
不会，只更新标志: No, it only updates the flags
CMP 使用减法的标志效果，但不保存差值到操作数。: CMP uses the flag effects of subtraction but does not store the difference in an operand.
while 在汇编里，还有一个 while 吗？: Is there still a while in the assembly?
把循环拆成比较、条件跳转、加法和回跳。修改 n，观察零次循环与多轮累加。: Break the loop into a comparison, a conditional jump, an addition and a jump back. Change n and watch zero iterations and repeated accumulation.
n = 0 时会执行循环体吗？每轮结束后，要回到哪一条指令重新判断？: Does the body run when n = 0? After each iteration, which instruction does it return to for the check?
ECX 保存 n，EDX 保存 i，EAX 保存 sum。XOR 一个寄存器与自: ECX holds n, EDX holds i, EAX holds sum. XOR of a register with itself gives zero, which initializes i and sum here; it also updates the four flags shown in this appendix.
退出判断与回边: The exit check and the back edge
cmp edx, ecx 检查 i 与 n，jae done 在 i ≥ n 时: cmp edx, ecx checks i against n, and jae done exits when i ≥ n. Otherwise it accumulates and updates i, then jmp returns to the comparison. Here n is unsigned and limited to 0–12, so every demo finishes within the replay limit.
不要依赖上一轮的标志: Do not rely on the previous iteration’s flags
循环体中的 ADD 会更新标志，回到条件处后 CMP 会重新计算正确的比较标志。: The ADD in the loop body updates the flags, and back at the condition CMP recomputes the correct comparison flags. One high-level while check may correspond to several low-level instructions.
JMP 不会自动更新循环变量，也不会自己检查结束条件。更新 i 和比较条件需要由: JMP does not update the loop variable or check the exit condition by itself. Other instructions must update i and compare.
用 n = 4 解释为什么输出为 6，条件检查为什么比循环体执行次数多一次。: With n = 4, explain why the output is 6 and why the condition is checked once more than the body runs.
循环累加 0、1、2、3，得到 6。i 更新为 4 后还要再比较一次，才能由 J: The loop adds 0, 1, 2, 3 to get 6. After i becomes 4, one more comparison is needed before JAE takes the exit path.
n = 0 时，这个 while 的循环体会执行几次？: With n = 0, how many times does the body of this while run?
第一次比较就有 i ≥ n，直接跳到 done。: The very first comparison finds i ≥ n and jumps straight to done.
a[i] 如何变成一次内存读取？: How does a[i] become one memory read?
修改数组与索引，对比直接读取和“先 LEA 算地址，再 MOV 读取”的两种写法: Change the array and the index, and compare a direct read with “LEA computes the address first, then MOV reads”.
int32_t 每项 4 字节。i 增加 1，访问地址会增加多少？LEA 会读出: Each int32_t takes 4 bytes. When i grows by 1, how much does the address grow? Does LEA read the array element?
地址是首地址加上偏移: An address is the base plus an offset
RCX 保存数组首地址，RDX 保存已零扩展的索引；有效地址是 RCX + RD: RCX holds the array’s base address and RDX the zero-extended index; the effective address is RCX + RDX × 4. The simulated base address 0x2000 is not a real address in this browser process.
LEA 把有效地址放进 R8，不读取这个地址里的值，也不改变标志。MOV 配合: LEA puts the effective address into R8 without reading the value at that address or changing the flags. Only MOV with a DWORD PTR memory operand reads 4 bytes. Switching between the two ways should give the same result, but the memory access happens in a different step.
本例按 x86 的小端字节顺序存储 int32_t：低地址放低字节。读出的 32: This example stores int32_t in x86 little-endian byte order: the low byte at the low address. The 32-bit pattern read goes into EAX, and the return value is interpreted as int32_t; e.g. FFFFFFFF means −1.
方括号表示访问内存，不表示“把地址本身读出来”。LEA 的地址表达式看起来相近，: Square brackets mean a memory access, not “read out the address itself”. LEA’s address expression looks similar, but it performs an address computation.
画出 a[2] 的地址计算过程，说明 LEA 后 R8 与 MOV 后 EAX: Draw the address computation for a[2], and say what R8 holds after LEA and what EAX holds after MOV.
0x2000 + 2 × 4 = 0x2008。LEA 后 R8 是地址 0x2: 0x2000 + 2 × 4 = 0x2008. After LEA, R8 holds the address 0x2008; after MOV, EAX holds the element’s bit pattern made of the 4 bytes there.
LEA R8, [RCX + RDX*4] 会读取数组元素吗？: Does LEA R8, [RCX + RDX*4] read the array element?
不会，只计算地址: No, it only computes the address
只读取第一个字节: It reads only the first byte
LEA 只计算有效地址；这里没有数据内存读取。: LEA only computes the effective address; there is no data memory read here.
CALL 之后，程序怎么知道从哪里回来？: After CALL, how does the program know where to come back to?
跟随 caller 调用 add，观察参数寄存器、32 字节 shadow sp: Follow caller as it calls add, and watch the argument registers, the 32-byte shadow space, stack alignment and the return location.
CALL 与 RET 各让 RSP 改变多少？返回值是否需要放在栈顶？: How much do CALL and RET each change RSP? Does the return value need to sit on top of the stack?
先由 ABI 约定参数位置: The ABI sets where arguments go
本例按 Windows x64 ABI，把两个 32 位参数写入 ECX、EDX: Following the Windows x64 ABI, this example writes the two 32-bit arguments to ECX and EDX. Before CALL, caller reserves 32 bytes of shadow space and subtracts another 8 bytes for this example’s alignment, sub rsp, 40 in total. Other platforms may use different calling conventions.
CALL 与 RET 维护返回位置: CALL and RET maintain the return location
CALL 把下一条指令的返回位置压入 8 字节栈槽，RSP 减 8，再转入 ad: CALL pushes the return location of the next instruction into an 8-byte stack slot, subtracts 8 from RSP, then transfers to add. RET reads that return location, adds 8 to RSP and continues in caller. The replay shows return locations as #instruction indexes, without faking byte addresses of real machine encoding.
返回值与恢复栈空间: Return value and restoring stack space
add 把 32 位返回值留在 EAX。caller 恢复自己预留的 40 字节: add leaves the 32-bit return value in EAX. caller restores the 40 bytes it reserved, then RETs to the external caller. Shadow space is reserved by the caller; the callee is not required to write register arguments into it. This example omits exception-unwinding metadata.
操作数栈、函数调用栈和返回值寄存器不是同一件事。本例没有像前面教学 VM 那样，: The operand stack, the function call stack and the return-value register are not the same thing. Unlike the earlier teaching VM, this example does not push every arithmetic input onto a stack.
追踪 RSP 从 0x1008 到 CALL、进入 add、返回 caller，: Trace RSP from 0x1008 through CALL, entering add, returning to caller and exiting, and point out where the return value is.
先减 40 得到 0xFE0；CALL 再减 8 得到 0xFD8。add 的: Subtracting 40 gives 0xFE0; CALL subtracts 8 more to 0xFD8. add’s RET pops back to 0xFE0; caller adds 40 to restore 0x1008, and the final RET pops to the external caller. The return value is in EAX.
本例 CALL 把什么放入栈中？: What does CALL put on the stack in this example?
下一条指令的返回位置: The return location of the next instruction
CALL 保存返回位置；整数返回值依调用约定放在寄存器里。: CALL saves the return location; by calling convention, the integer return value goes in a register.
AX、EAX、RAX 是三块不同的寄存器吗？: Are AX, EAX and RAX three different registers?
通过同一个 64 位寄存器的不同窗口，复习 AX / AL / AH，并观察写: Review AX / AL / AH as different windows onto the same 64-bit register, and watch the high bits being cleared when EAX is written.
RAX 初值为 1122334455667788h，分别写入 AX 与 EAX，: RAX starts as 1122334455667788h. When you write AX and EAX, which bits are kept?
名字是同一块寄存器的窗口: The names are windows onto one register
RAX 是 64 位窗口，EAX 是低 32 位，AX 是低 16 位，AL 是: RAX is the 64-bit window, EAX the low 32 bits, AX the low 16 bits, AL the low 8 bits, and AH bits 8–15. This is always a demo in x86-64 mode, not an 8086 instruction simulator.
写入规则存在重要区别: Write rules differ in important ways
写 AL、AH、AX 会保留其他位；写 EAX 则把 RAX 的高 32 位清零: Writing AL, AH or AX keeps the other bits; writing EAX clears the high 32 bits of RAX; writing RAX overwrites all 64 bits. This is not sign extension. Note that AH has extra restrictions when combined with a REX prefix; the MOV immediates in this example do not hit that conflict.
保留旧知识，再建立新坐标: Keep the old knowledge, then add new coordinates
8086 的 16 位寄存器、标志与跳转直觉仍有用。现代代码还要明确操作数宽度、: Intuitions about the 8086’s 16-bit registers, flags and jumps are still useful. Modern code also needs explicit operand widths, 64-bit addresses and the ABI. Segmentation, paging, interrupts, DOS services, the full flag set and SIMD are outside this appendix’s simulation.
写 EAX 并不是只改 RAX 的低 32 位；高 32 位会清零。写 AX 则: Writing EAX does not just change the low 32 bits of RAX; the high 32 bits are cleared. Writing AX keeps the high bits.
分别用 AX、EAX 写入 00AAh，解释 RAX 的最终值。再试试 AH 与: Write 00AAh through AX and then through EAX, and explain the final value of RAX. Then try AH and AL, and name the byte each one overwrites.
写 AX 后是 11223344556600AAh；写 EAX 后是 00000: After writing AX it is 11223344556600AAh; after writing EAX it is 00000000000000AAh. AH overwrites the second byte from the low end, AL the lowest byte.
在 64 位模式下，写 EAX 会怎样处理 RAX 的高 32 位？: In 64-bit mode, what happens to the high 32 bits of RAX when EAX is written?
按符号位填充: They are filled with the sign bit
32 位目的寄存器的写入会零扩展到对应的 64 位寄存器。: Writing a 32-bit destination register zero-extends into the corresponding 64-bit register.
读右侧、写左侧，源保留。内存操作数会发生读取或写入；本例标志不变。: Reads the right, writes the left, keeps the source. Memory operands cause a read or write; flags are unchanged in this example.
结果写回左侧，按操作数宽度回绕；更新 ZF、SF、CF、OF。: Writes the result to the left, wrapping at the operand width; updates ZF, SF, CF, OF.
左减右，写回左侧并更新标志。本例也用它分配栈空间。: Left minus right, written to the left with updated flags. This example also uses it to allocate stack space.
临时计算左减右，更新标志但不改操作数。: Temporarily computes left minus right and updates the flags without changing the operands.
相同寄存器异或得到零；本例更新 ZF/SF 并把 CF/OF 清零。: XOR of a register with itself gives zero; in this example it updates ZF/SF and clears CF/OF.

For example, [0-9]+ means “at least one digit”, and [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]* means “a letter followed by letters or digits”. Give each regex a name and you have a lexical rule. The remaining question: how does the program turn a regex into a state machine that can scan?
第一步：像搭积木一样把正则画成图: Step 1: draw the regex as a graph, like building blocks
每一小段正则都对应一小块图，有一个起点和一个终点。单个字符 a 就是“起点 —a: Each small piece of regex corresponds to a small piece of graph with a start and an end. A single character a is one edge “start —a→ end”. Two pieces in a row (ab) use the first piece’s end as the second piece’s start. “Either-or” (a|b) splits into two branches from the start that rejoin at the end. “Repetition” (a*) can be skipped, or loop back and go around again. Branches and “skips” use ε edges, which read no character.

图里有岔路，有时同一个字符能走两条路，还有不读字符就能走的 ε 边。所以它叫 N: The graph has branches: sometimes one character can take two paths, and ε edges can be taken without reading a character. That is why it is called an NFA, a nondeterministic finite automaton. Matching with it means picking one path to try and going back to try another when it fails — backtracking. When the book matches intA, it first follows the int path to its end, finds an A still left, and has to go back to the start and take the identifier path instead.
第二步：不挑路，把可能性一起记住: Step 2: don’t pick a path — remember all the possibilities at once
与其挑一条路，不如同时记住“现在可能站在哪几个状态上”。比如读完 i，既可能在: Instead of picking a path, remember “which states we might be in right now”. After reading i, for example, we might be on the int path or on the identifier path, so record those two states together as one new state. States reachable along ε edges without reading a character count too; this step is called computing the ε-closure. For each character read, compute the next set of possible states (called move), then take the ε-closure again. The new graph has only one path at every step and is called a DFA. This method is the subset construction.

扫描时不会一到能接受的状态就停下。它会一直读到无路可走，再回到最后一次能接受的位: Scanning does not stop as soon as it reaches an accepting state. It keeps reading until there is no way forward, then goes back to the last accepting position, so intA is one identifier, not int plus A. This is the longest match. If one position fits two rules at once — int fits both Int and Id — the rule order decides: the earlier rule wins.
正则可以机械地翻译成 NFA: A regex can be translated into an NFA mechanically
字符 i 是一条 i → f 的边；s|t 先用 ε 分叉，再用 ε 汇合；st: A character i is one edge i → f; s|t forks with ε and rejoins with ε; st merges the end state of s with the start state of t; s* can skip via ε or loop back from the end to the start; s+ has no skip edge and runs at least once; s? can only skip or run once. Each rule is entered from the overall start state via ε, and its end state is marked with the rule name.
NFA 要试探，DFA 只走一条路: An NFA has to probe; a DFA follows one path
NFA 的某个状态对同一个输入可能有多条路，还可能有不读字符的 ε 边。回溯实现: An NFA state may have several paths for the same input, plus ε edges that read nothing. A backtracking implementation tries one, goes back to the fork on failure and tries another; in the worst case the number of attempts grows exponentially. The subset construction merges “all states the NFA might be in after reading the current prefix” into one DFA state: first take the ε-closure, then compute move and closure for each input class. Matching then looks up the table once per character; the cost moves to construction time, and some regexes make the number of DFA states multiply.
多条规则：最长匹配，再看优先级: Several rules: longest match first, then priority
扫描器一直向前读，记住最近一次到达接受状态的位置；无路可走时回到那里生成 Tok: The scanner keeps reading forward and remembers the last position where it reached an accepting state; when there is no way forward, it goes back there to emit a Token and returns the extra characters to the input. If one DFA state contains accepting states of several rules, the earlier rule wins: int fits both Int and Id, so Int must come first. A rule that can match the empty string cannot produce a Token on its own, or the scanner would spin in place.
扫描器并不是“一到接受状态就生成 Token”。它先走到无路可走，再回退到最近的: The scanner does not “emit a Token as soon as it reaches an accepting state”. It first goes until there is no way forward, then backs up to the last accepting position. Also, rule order decides who wins a conflict: write keywords after identifiers and the keyword rule never wins.

从教学寄存器机到真实指令集: From the teaching register machine to a real instruction set
实验 17 的寄存器机里，每条三地址指令恰好变成一条寄存器指令，K 个寄存器完全: In lab 17’s register machine, each three-address instruction becomes exactly one register instruction, the K registers are fully interchangeable, and there are no flags. Real x86-64 is different: add overwrites its left operand (two-address form), immediates are usually at most 32 bits, division must use rdx:rax, comparisons put their result in flags first, and calls clobber some registers. Code generation has to deal with all of these differences at once.

先把三地址代码接回成树: First reassemble three-address code into trees
实验 04 按后序遍历把表达式压平成 t0、t1……。如果一个临时值只被用一次，: Lab 04 flattens expressions into t0, t1… by post-order traversal. If a temporary is used only once, right afterwards in the same basic block, it is folded back into its use, giving an expression tree. Only the temporary on “top of the stack” is merged, so re-expanding in post-order keeps the order of operations from the original IR, and with it the order of division-by-zero and overflow errors.
用指令模式覆盖树：最大吞进: Cover the tree with instruction patterns: maximal munch
每条机器指令能“盖住”树上的一小片节点，像一块瓦片。最大吞进（maximal m: Each machine instruction can “cover” a small patch of tree nodes, like a tile. Maximal munch starts at the root and repeatedly chooses the pattern that covers the most nodes, then handles the remaining subtrees: comparison and conditional jump fuse into cmp + jge, adding an immediate uses lea, multiplying by an immediate uses three-operand imul, and 0 − x uses neg. Per-instruction templates serve as a baseline: first compute x < 10 as 0 / 1 into a register, then test + je.

语言的语义决定额外的检查: The language’s semantics decide the extra checks
原书第 08 讲里，clang -O2 用一条 leal 10(%rdi,%rs: In lecture 08 of the book, clang -O2 adds three numbers with a single leal 10(%rdi,%rsi), %eax. That holds in C because signed overflow is undefined behavior there, so the compiler need not keep intermediate results. In this project’s language every intermediate result must be a safe integer or an error is raised, and a 64-bit register can hold 2^53 without the CPU complaining. So after each add, subtract and multiply the result is compared with the bound in r11; multiplication checks jo first, and division tests the divisor beforehand. 0 − x cannot go out of range and needs no check.
固定寄存器与调用约定：预着色: Fixed registers and calling conventions: precoloring
cqo / idiv 固定读写 rax 和 rdx；print 的参数按 Sys: cqo / idiv always read and write rax and rdx; print’s argument goes in rdi per the System V AMD64 convention; after each call, the nine caller-saved registers rax, rcx, rdx, rsi, rdi, r8–r11 can no longer be trusted. The allocator puts these physical registers into the interference graph as nodes that are “already colored”: values live across a call get edges to all caller-saved registers, so they can only get callee-saved registers rbx, r12–r15, or spill to the stack.
mov rdi, rbx ; 参数固定在 rdi\ncall:
mov rdi, rbx          ; argument fixed in rdi
call __mc_print_int   ; afterwards rax rcx rdx rsi rdi r8–r11 are unknown
lea rbx, [rbx + 1]    ; total lives across calls, so it must stay in callee-saved rbx
用到的 callee-saved 寄存器要在序曲里 push、尾声里 pop；溢: Callee-saved registers in use are pushed in the prologue and popped in the epilogue; spilled values live in stack slots at [rbp − offset]. System V requires rsp to be 16-byte aligned at each call, so the number of stack slots plus saved registers is padded to a multiple of 16. The simulator checks alignment at each call, checks at ret that callee-saved registers and rsp are restored, and marks caller-saved registers as unknown after each call; if the generated code breaks any of these, it reports a “machine-level error”.

push rbx            ; callee-saved, save before use
sub rsp, 8          ; 1 stack slot, padded so rsp is 16-aligned at call
…
add rsp, 8
pop rbx
pop rbp

指令选择是覆盖问题: Instruction selection is a covering problem
同一棵树有多种覆盖方式，要选代价更低的组合。最大吞进是贪心算法，得到的是局部最优: The same tree can be covered in several ways, and the cheaper combination should win. Maximal munch is greedy and finds a local optimum: no two adjacent tiles can be replaced by one cheaper tile, but the total is not guaranteed to be cheapest. Dynamic programming or BURS (bottom-up rewrite systems) can find the global optimum; this page implements only maximal munch and compares instruction counts with per-instruction templates.
约束先变成干涉边，再着色: Constraints first become interference edges, then get colored
两地址形式、固定寄存器和调用破坏，都变成虚拟寄存器与物理寄存器之间的干涉边；mo: The two-address form, fixed registers and call clobbers all become interference edges between virtual and physical registers; the two ends of a mov prefer the same register, and after allocation that mov becomes a self-copy and is deleted. Coloring, spilling and rewriting work as in lab 17, except the colors are real register names.
最后用真实执行核对: Finally, check by actually running it
核对分两层：先在最终的虚拟寄存器代码上重算活跃性，检查每次写入都不会覆盖仍要使用: The check has two layers: first recompute liveness on the final virtual-register code and check that no write overwrites a value still needed; then the simulator executes the physical code instruction by instruction and compares output and errors with the original VM. Matching on one run only shows agreement for this input; it is not a general proof of equivalence.
“指令选择就是查表，把每条 IR 换成一条机器指令。”——同一片树可以有多种覆盖: “Instruction selection is just a table lookup that replaces each IR instruction with one machine instruction.” — The same patch of tree can be covered in several ways: x < 10 plus a branch can be setcc + test + je, or fused into cmp + jge; a + 10 can be mov + add, or a single lea. Also, the book’s -O2 can do a + b + 10 in one lea only because signed overflow in C is undefined behavior; when the language requires overflow to raise an error, not a single intermediate check can be dropped.
目标是 x86-64 子集，Intel 语法，System V AMD64 调用: The target is an x86-64 subset in Intel syntax with the System V AMD64 calling convention; only a single main function is generated, and it prints and reports errors through three runtime functions, __mc_print_int / __mc_print_bool / __mc_trap; r11 is reserved for range checks. int is a 64-bit two’s-complement register value, bool is 0 / 1. Page results come from this project’s x86-64 subset simulator (BigInt 64-bit registers, ZF / SF / OF / CF, a downward-growing stack), not a real CPU, and were not verified with an assembler on this machine; the exported .s and runtime C code can be assembled and run on x86-64 Linux yourself. Not included: memory operands, optimal covering by dynamic programming / BURS, real copy coalescing (only preference coloring), interval splitting, function calls and argument passing (see the lab 16 dialect), instruction scheduling and peephole optimization (see lab 18). Maximal munch only merges temporaries used once within the same basic block; spilled values are reloaded from their stack slot at every use, with no rematerialization or local reuse. Execution is limited to 20000 machine instructions and the replay keeps the first 400 steps; step units differ from the original VM, and if either side hits its limit no agreement is claimed.
运行“原书例子：a + b + 10”，数一数机器代码里有几条 lea、几条检查: Run “Book example: a + b + 10” and count how many lea and check instructions the machine code has; then explain why it cannot be merged into one lea 10(%rdi,%rsi) like the book’s -O2. Next switch to “Values across calls”, set the registers to “tight”, and see which of total and i stays in rbx and which spills to the stack.
a + b + 10 被接回成 Add(Add(a, b), 10)，覆盖成两条: a + b + 10 is reassembled as Add(Add(a, b), 10) and covered by two leas, each followed by 6 range-check instructions. A single merged lea would check only the final result: if a + b already exceeds the safe range and is still out of range after + 10, the error is the same; but if the intermediate result goes out of range and adding a negative constant brings it back, the merged version would miss the error. This project requires an error for every out-of-range step, so it must check step by step. With tight registers, rbx is the only callee-saved register, while both total and i are live across the print calls: i stays in rbx, total spills to [rbp − 16], and every read or write of total in the loop goes to the stack.
在 x86-64 System V 约定下，一个值在 call 之后还要使用，分: Under the x86-64 System V convention, can the allocator keep a value in rcx if it is still needed after a call?
可以，只要调用之前把值写进 rcx: Yes, as long as the value is written to rcx before the call
不可以，call 可能破坏 rcx 等全部 caller-saved 寄存器；它: No: a call may clobber rcx and every other caller-saved register; it can only use a callee-saved register (saved in the prologue) or spill to the stack
可以，只要被调用的函数没有用到 rcx: Yes, as long as the called function does not use rcx
调用约定只保证 callee-saved 寄存器在返回后不变。调用者不能假设被调: The calling convention guarantees only that callee-saved registers are unchanged after return. The caller cannot assume the callee leaves rcx alone; the allocator treats call as writing every caller-saved register, so values live across a call interfere with all of them.

逐轮求出必经块，再观察直接支配树、自然循环和支配边界。尝试找一条绕过候选块的路径: Compute the must-pass blocks round by round, then look at the immediate dominator tree, natural loops and dominance frontiers. Try to find a path that bypasses a candidate block, to test what “must pass” really means.
支配是所有入口路径的共同约束: Dominance is a constraint shared by every path from the entry
如果从入口到 B 的每条 CFG 路径都经过 A，A 就支配 B；每个可达块也支: If every CFG path from the entry to B passes through A, then A dominates B; every reachable block also dominates itself. The entry’s set is just itself; every other block starts with all reachable blocks and shrinks repeatedly using “itself ∪ the intersection of the dominator sets of all reachable predecessors”. The immediate dominator is the nearest must-pass block, not necessarily a predecessor directly connected in the CFG; together they form the dominator tree.
循环头必须支配回边的起点: The loop header must dominate the source of the back edge
对边 latch → header，只有 header 支配 latch 时才把: An edge latch → header counts as a natural-loop back edge only if header dominates latch. Collecting predecessors backward from latch and stopping at header finds the loop members. Back edges with the same header merge, and loops can nest; a preheader lies outside the loop and has a single successor, header. Distinguish exiting blocks inside the loop from exit blocks outside it, and do not call every edge drawn upward a natural-loop back edge.
支配边界是理解 φ 位置的桥梁: Dominance frontiers are the bridge to φ placement
DF(A) 包含这些块：A 支配它的某个前驱，却不严格支配它本身。循环头可以出现: DF(A) contains the blocks where A dominates some predecessor but does not strictly dominate the block itself. A loop header can be in its own dominance frontier. Put a variable’s defining blocks on a worklist and iterate along dominance frontiers, treating each new φ candidate as a new definition to propagate further. A φ picks one version according to the predecessor edge it is entered on; it does not add the values. Full SSA still needs renaming and validation. This page does no liveness pruning, so some candidates may be unnecessary.
本次执行经过一个块，不代表它支配后面的块。反过来，while 条件本次为 fal: That this run passes through a block does not mean it dominates the blocks after it. Conversely, a while condition being false this time does not make the structural loop in the original CFG disappear. All structural edges are kept here and constant propagation does not remove edges; a structural path does not guarantee that all its conditions can hold at once.
分析原始 IR 的入口可达 CFG：迭代支配集合、直接支配者、支配边界、自然循环: Analyzes the entry-reachable CFG of the original IR: iterated dominator sets, immediate dominators, dominance frontiers, natural loops and unpruned iterated φ candidates. At most 200 rounds, and nothing further is published without convergence; the replay keeps at most 240 block visits, and the final sets are complete. This is not the Lengauer–Tarjan algorithm and does not enumerate every directed cycle or irreducible region. This page does not rewrite the program; continue to lab 13 “Static Single Assignment” to see φ pruning, version renaming and execution.
选“两条路径的共同必经块”。解释为什么某个分支块不能支配汇合块，并找到绕过它的结: Choose “Shared must-pass block of two paths”. Explain why a branch block cannot dominate the merge block, and find the structural path that bypasses it. Then choose nested loops, point out both headers, their latches and loop members, and finally explain why a loop header can be a φ candidate.
分支的另一条路径可以绕过该分支块，因此它不是汇合块的必经点；两条路径共同经过的入: The other path of the branch can bypass the branch block, so it is not a must-pass point for the merge block; the entry that both paths pass through still dominates the merge block. A natural loop is collected backward from an edge whose target dominates its source, and inner members are contained in the outer loop. A loop header receives both the initial value from the entry and the updated value from the back edge, so iterated dominance frontiers list it as a candidate; whether to keep the φ still needs further analysis.

从操作数栈继续，加入带类型的函数、按值传参与返回。跟随真实 CALL / RET: Continuing from the operand stack, add typed functions, pass-by-value arguments and returns. Follow real CALL / RETURN and inspect each call’s stack frame, pause position and separate local variables.
先区分两个栈: First tell the two stacks apart
实验 06 的操作数栈暂存一次表达式的中间值。函数调用还需要记住：谁正在执行、它: Lab 06’s operand stack holds the intermediate values of one expression. Function calls also need to remember who is running, what its local variables are, and where to return when done. The call stack organizes these unfinished calls last-in, first-out; in this lab each stack frame also gets its own operand stack.
先登记签名，再检查函数体: Register signatures first, then check bodies
定义写出返回类型、函数名和形参类型。编译器先收集全部签名，因此函数可以相互调用；: A definition gives the return type, the function name and the parameter types. The compiler collects all signatures first, so functions can call each other; then it checks argument counts, types and return values. A function body only looks in its own lexical scope and cannot read the caller’s or top-level locals.
实参求值属于调用者: Argument evaluation belongs to the caller
本实验明确规定从左到右、各求值一次，再把得到的 int / bool 值绑定到新: This lab specifies left to right, each evaluated once, and the resulting int / bool values are bound to the parameters of the new frame. Parameters are copies of values: changing a parameter inside the function does not change the caller’s variable. This evaluation order is a convention of the teaching language; do not infer C’s argument evaluation order from it.
调用者暂停在 CALL 后的下一条字节码。新帧保存返回位置，拥有独立局部变量表，: The caller pauses at the bytecode after CALL. The new frame saves the return location, has its own local-variable table and starts at PC 0 of the callee. A PC on this page is a bytecode index within the function, not a real machine memory address.
递归共享代码，每次调用各有一帧: Recursion shares code, but each call gets its own frame
fact(4) 和 fact(3) 使用相同的函数字节码，却有不同的帧编号、形参: fact(4) and fact(3) use the same function bytecode but have different frame numbers, parameters n and pending multiplications. The 4 and 3 kept on the callers’ operand stacks explain why computation continues as the recursion returns.
RETURN 恢复调用者，异常暂停整条调用链: RETURN resumes the caller; an error pauses the whole call chain
返回表达式先算出一个值，随后当前帧出栈，该值压入调用者操作数栈，接着原来的 PC: The return expression computes a value first; then the current frame is popped, the value is pushed onto the caller’s operand stack, and execution continues at the saved PC. Division by zero or overflow stops the program; output already produced is kept, and the call chain stays at the scene of the error for inspection. There is no exception catching or unwinding here. Without side-effect analysis, the old optimizer is not applied to function calls either.
一段函数代码，多份活动状态: One piece of function code, many activation states
栈帧（Stack frame / Activation record）对应一次尚: A stack frame (activation record) corresponds to one unfinished call, not to one function definition. During recursion the same parameter slot name appears many times, while the actual values live in different frames.
静态作用域与动态调用链分开看: Keep static scope and the dynamic call chain apart
变量名在编译时绑定到本函数的声明槽位；运行时，槽位放进当前帧。同名块变量也有不同: Variable names are bound at compile time to declaration slots of their function; at run time the slots go into the current frame. Block variables with the same name also get different slots. Call names are resolved in a separate function table and are unaffected by locals with the same name. The interface keeps allocated slots visible for inspection, but after leaving a block the source can no longer refer to that binding.
调用约定是明确的协议: A calling convention is an explicit protocol
这里约定左到右求值、按值绑定、每帧独立操作数栈和单值返回。Cornell 讲义介: Here the convention is left-to-right evaluation, binding by value, a separate operand stack per frame and single-value returns. The Cornell notes cover the real RISC-V calling convention and the author’s implementation covers frames in a stack VM; this lab borrows only the concepts and generates no matching ABI or machine instructions.
“递归第二次调用会覆盖第一次的 n”把函数代码与活动状态混在了一起。代码可以共用: “The second recursive call overwrites the first n” mixes up function code with activation state. Code can be shared; every CALL creates a separate frame, and the old n and the pending operation remain in the paused caller. Pushing a value onto the operand stack is not the same as creating a call frame either.
专用函数方言，复用基础扫描器和安全整数运算；直接生成函数字节码，不接入现有 CF: A dedicated function dialect that reuses the basic scanner and safe-integer arithmetic; it generates function bytecode directly and is not wired into the existing CFG, SSA, optimizer or assembly templates. Supports top-level int / bool functions, up to 8 parameters, single-value return, recursion and mutual recursion, block scopes, if / while and print. Top-level statements go into a separate entry frame automatically, and top-level variables are not globals. A function must have a statically provable complete return path: return, a later return in sequence, or returns on both sides of if / else; while never counts as a guaranteed return. No void, prototypes, overloading, closures, reference parameters, exception handling or tail-call optimization. At most 2000 characters, 24 functions, 32 active frames (including the top level) and 2000 executed instructions; hitting a limit only means a pause. The first 400 states and the final scene are kept, with a clear notice when states are omitted.

fact(4)、fact(3)、fact(2) 的 n 分别为 4、3、2；暂停: fact(4), fact(3) and fact(2) have n = 4, 3 and 2; the first two paused frames still hold the left operand waiting for multiplication. fact(4) calls fact 4 times in total, with a maximum depth of 5 including the top level, and returns 24; fact(0) goes straight to the base case, calls once with depth 2, and returns 1.

覆盖所有调用层同名变量，从函数入口继续: It overwrites same-named variables at every call level and continues from the function entry
压入调用者的操作数栈，从 CALL 后的下一条指令继续: It is pushed onto the caller’s operand stack, and the caller continues at the instruction after CALL
再创建一个新栈帧，从顶层重新开始: Another new stack frame is created and execution restarts from the top level
被调帧退出，调用者的局部变量和中间值仍然保留；返回值成为原表达式的一个操作数，继: The callee frame exits while the caller’s locals and intermediate values remain; the return value becomes an operand of the original expression, and the paused computation continues.

对应第 32 讲：编辑一个堆，写出对象大小、引用、根和程序对引用的修改，再看引用: Corresponds to lecture 32: edit a heap with object sizes, references, roots and the program’s changes to references, then see what reference counting, cycle detection, mark-sweep with tri-color marking, mark-compact and stop-and-copy each reclaim, and whether the remaining space is contiguous.
垃圾就是从根走不到的对象: Garbage is whatever the roots cannot reach
根是程序能直接拿到的引用：全局变量、栈上的局部变量、寄存器。从根出发沿引用能到达: Roots are the references a program can get at directly: globals, locals on the stack, registers. Objects reachable from the roots along references may still be used; for unreachable ones the program can never get their address again, so they are garbage. When A becomes unreachable, C, referenced only by A, becomes garbage too; D, still referenced by B, stays alive.
root B\nA 2 -> C, D // 不可达\nB 2 -> D\n:
root B
A 2 -> C, D   // unreachable
B 2 -> D
C 2           // referenced only by A: garbage
D 2           // still referenced by B: alive
每个对象记下有多少根或对象指向它。程序每改一次引用就加 1 或减 1，计数到 0: Each object records how many roots or objects point to it. Every change of a reference adds or subtracts 1; when a count reaches 0 the object is reclaimed at once, and each object it references drops by 1. The whole program never has to stop, which is why Python and Swift use it.
引用计数的软肋：循环引用: The weak spot of reference counting: reference cycles
几个对象互相引用、却没有根指向它们时，它们已是垃圾，计数却都还是 1。Pytho: When a few objects reference each other but no root points to them, they are already garbage, yet their counts are all still 1. Python runs periodic cycle detection: set gc_ref to the count and subtract references between objects; objects still above 0 must be referenced by roots, so everything reachable from them is kept and the rest is cyclic garbage.
a -> b -> c -> d -> a\n没有根指向它们，计数都是 1:
a -> b -> c -> d -> a
no root points to them, and every count is 1
一开始所有对象是白色。根引用的对象变灰，放进待处理区；取出一个灰色对象，把它引用: At first every object is white. Objects referenced by roots turn gray and go into the worklist; take out a gray object, turn the white objects it references gray, and turn it black. When the worklist is empty, black objects are alive and white ones are garbage. The sweep phase scans the whole heap by address and returns the space of white objects to the free list.
碎片：总空间够，却放不下: Fragmentation: enough space in total, yet it doesn’t fit
清除后，空闲空间散落在存活对象之间。申请一块较大的内存时，即使空闲总量够，也可能: After sweeping, free space is scattered between live objects. A request for a larger block may find no contiguous space even though the free total is enough. Mark-compact slides live objects to one end after marking; stop-and-copy copies live objects into the other half of the space, so allocation only needs to bump a pointer, at the cost of always leaving half the space idle.
为什么要停下程序: Why the program has to stop
标记要从所有根出发一次走完，整理和拷贝还会改对象地址，所以追踪式收集通常要在安全: Marking has to walk from every root in one go, and compacting and copying even change object addresses, so tracing collection usually stops the whole program at a safe point. Generational, incremental and concurrent collection all aim to shorten the pause; reference counting spreads the work over every reference change instead. This page does one full collection and does not simulate pause times.
各种算法回收的都应是不可达对象的子集；追踪式算法回收全部不可达对象，引用计数漏掉: What any algorithm reclaims should be a subset of the unreachable objects; tracing algorithms reclaim all of them, while reference counting misses cycles. The page checks every algorithm with an independent reachability computation instead of trusting a single implementation.
回收之后还要能分配: After reclaiming, allocation still has to work
比较不能只看回收了多少格，还要看剩余空间是否连续。完成页对每种算法尝试申请同样大: Comparison should not look only at how many cells were reclaimed, but also at whether the remaining space is contiguous. The final page tries a request of the same size with each algorithm and lists the largest contiguous free block.
程序只能改它拿得到的引用: A program can only change references it can get at
%% 下方的操作代表程序在运行中改引用。程序拿不到不可达对象的地址，所以只能连接: The operations below %% stand for the program changing references while it runs. The program cannot get the address of unreachable objects, so it can only link and change currently reachable ones; this also guarantees that reference counting never reclaims an object still in use.
“计数为 0 才是垃圾，计数不为 0 就还在用”只说对了一半：计数为 0 一定是: “Count 0 means garbage, a non-zero count means still in use” is only half right: a count of 0 is certainly garbage, but garbage in a reference cycle has non-zero counts. Another misconception is “if the total space reclaimed is enough, allocation will succeed”: the fragments left by mark-sweep may not fit a larger object.
教学堆模型：对象按声明顺序连续存放，大小为 1–8 格，堆最多 128 格，最多: Teaching heap model: objects are stored contiguously in declaration order, sized 1–8 cells, with a heap of at most 128 cells, at most 24 objects of 6 references each, 24 operations and 1200 characters of input. Only one full collection is simulated: no generations, incremental or concurrent collection, write barriers, safe points, finalizers or weak references; cycle detection follows the Python gc idea described in lecture 32 and does not distinguish container objects or generations. Stop-and-copy splits the heap in half and flags honestly when the initial objects do not fit in half the heap; mark-compact slides in address order. Space is measured in cells, not real bytes or object headers.
选“断开引用后形成循环”，说出 cut 之后引用计数立即回收了谁、漏掉了谁，循环: Choose “A cycle forms after cutting a reference” and say whom reference counting reclaims right after cut, whom it misses, and whom cycle detection recovers. cut app -> cache 让 cache 的计数降到 0，立即回收；no: cut app -> cache drops cache’s count to 0, so it is reclaimed at once; node1 therefore drops from 2 to 1. node1 and node2 reference each other with counts of 1, so reference counting cannot reclaim them; after cycle detection subtracts the references between them, both have gc_ref 0, and no object with gc_ref above 0 reaches them, so they are judged garbage. So one peek at the next Token tells you which to choose, with no trying at all. “Which Tokens an alternative can start with” is its FIRST set. 调用图与自底向上的效果摘要: The call graph and bottom-up effect summaries
调用图里每个函数是一个点，每条调用是一条边。按强连通分量（Tarjan 算法）分: In the call graph, each function is a node and each call an edge. Grouping by strongly connected components (Tarjan’s algorithm): functions in the same group reach each other, which is recursion. Summarize from the leaves up: a function with print “prints”; one with +, -, * “may fail” (overflow), as does division by anything but a non-zero constant (division by zero); one with a loop or in a recursion cycle “may not terminate”; and calling another function inherits all of its effects. Only a function with none of the three is pure. This language has no globals or reference parameters, and a call cannot read or write the caller’s locals — the language itself guarantees there are no memory effects.

Inside the function, conditional constant propagation follows only the branches the conditions allow and merges all returns into the return value. “调用的结果没人用，就可以把调用删掉”和“函数总返回同一个常量，就可以把调用换成: “If nobody uses a call’s result, the call can be deleted” and “if a function always returns the same constant, the call can become that constant” both hold only for pure functions. For a function that prints, may divide by zero or overflow, or may not terminate, the call must stay even when its result is known — optimization may propagate the result but must not swallow the effects.

Effect summaries only distinguish output, may-fail (unfolded +, -, *, and division by anything but a non-zero constant; 0 − x excepted) and may-not-terminate (loops or recursion cycles); they do not distinguish error kinds and are not context-sensitive. Interprocedural constant propagation merges arguments over all executed call sites, with conditional constant propagation inside functions; the transformations are constant substitution and folding, constant branches, deletion of unreachable code and uncalled functions, folding or deleting calls to pure functions, and cleanup of useless pure writes, for at most 4 iterations. Inlining only handles non-recursive functions of at most 16 instructions, expanding bottom-up over the call graph, with expanded functions of at most 4000 instructions. A fully expanded main goes to lab 05’s optimizer (all three options on) and the stack VM; this step is skipped while a call remains. The IR interpreter is limited to 32 frames and 2000 steps like lab 16’s VM, but counts steps differently; the stack VM also allows 2000 bytecode instructions. No tail calls, procedure cloning (specializing copies per call site), escape analysis or profile-guided inlining.
