加减层调用乘除层，乘除层再读取一元运算和基本表达式。因此 2 + 3 * 4 中: The addition level calls the multiplication level, which reads unary operations and primary expressions. So in 2 + 3 * 4 the multiplication subtree is built first and becomes the right child of the addition. Parentheses start a full expression parse again.
加减层先取左项，再循环读取运算符和右项，每次把已有子树作为新节点的左孩子。因此: The addition level takes the left operand first, then loops reading an operator and a right operand, each time making the existing subtree the left child of the new node. So the tree for 10 - 3 - 2 means (10 - 3) - 2, not 10 - (3 - 2).
AST 省略了语法外壳: The AST drops the syntactic shell
括号与分号参与解析，却通常不成为独立的 AST 节点。运算顺序已经编码在树的连接: Parentheses and semicolons take part in parsing but usually do not become separate AST nodes. The order of operations is already encoded in how the tree is connected. This lab shows the final tree and highlights the node just built during the replay.
语法正确只说明结构符合文法；引用不存在的变量也可能成功构建 AST。: Syntactically correct only means the structure fits the grammar; an AST can be built even when it refers to a variable that does not exist.
预测式递归下降，固定的表达式文法；没有通用 LL/LR 表生成、错误恢复与多错误: Predictive recursive descent with a fixed expression grammar; no general LL/LR table generation, error recovery or multiple-error reporting.
分别画出 10 - 3 - 2 和 10 - (3 - 2) 的树，解释哪个减号: Draw the trees for 10 - 3 - 2 and 10 - (3 - 2), and explain which minus is at the root.
前者最后一个减号在根部，左孩子为 10 - 3；后者第一个减号在根部，右孩子为: In the first, the last minus is at the root with left child 10 - 3; in the second, the first minus is at the root with right child 3 - 2. They give 5 and 9.
2 + 3 * 4 对应表达式子树的根节点是什么？: What is the root of the expression subtree for 2 + 3 * 4?
乘法先成为子树，再被加法引用。树根的操作最后执行。: The multiplication becomes a subtree first and is then referenced by the addition. The operation at the root runs last.
同一个名字，指向同一个变量吗？: Does the same name always refer to the same variable?
进入和退出语句块，追踪符号表与引用绑定。让一段语法正确的代码，接受作用域与类型的: Enter and leave blocks, and follow the symbol table and how references bind. Let syntactically correct code go through scope and type checks.
从内向外查找声明: Look up declarations from the inside out
每个语句块创建一个词法作用域。引用变量时从当前作用域向外查找，首次找到的声明就是: Each block creates a lexical scope. A variable reference is looked up from the current scope outward, and the first declaration found is what it binds to. An inner variable with the same name can shadow an outer one; after leaving the block it is no longer visible.
每个声明获得独立的内部名称，例如 v0_x 与 v1_x。后续生成中间代码时使用: Each declaration gets its own internal name, such as v0_x and v1_x. Later intermediate code uses the internal names, so the x of two scopes never gets mixed up. A duplicate declaration at the same level is rejected.
字面量直接带有 int 或 bool 类型；变量类型来自符号表；算术节点要求两个: Literals carry type int or bool directly; variable types come from the symbol table; arithmetic nodes require both operands to be int. Declarations and assignments then compare the target type with the expression type. This language does no implicit type conversion.
是否允许内部变量遮蔽外部变量，由具体语言规定。本实验允许遮蔽，不能把规则直接当成: Whether an inner variable may shadow an outer one is up to each language. This lab allows shadowing; do not take its rules for Java’s.
只有 int、bool 和块作用域；初始化表达式先求值，随后引入新绑定。未实现函: Only int, bool and block scopes; the initializer is evaluated first, then the new binding is introduced. Functions, closures, overloading and generics are not implemented.
用遮蔽预设说明两次 print(x) 的查找路径。把内部声明改成 x = 20;: Use the shadowing preset to explain the lookup path of both print(x). What happens if you change the inner declaration to x = 20;?
内部声明时绑定独立，先输出 20，退出后输出外层的 10。改为赋值会找到外层的: With the inner declaration the binding is separate: it prints 20 first, then the outer 10 after leaving. With an assignment, lookup finds the outer x and changes it, so both print 20.
int count = true; 最早应该在哪一阶段被拒绝？: At which stage should int count = true; be rejected first?
Token 和声明结构都合法，但 int 与 bool 不兼容；这是类型检查的工: The Tokens and the declaration structure are both valid, but int and bool are incompatible; that is the job of type checking.
一棵树，如何变成线性的指令？: How does a tree become linear instructions?
后序遍历表达式，把每个运算拆成一条三地址指令。高亮源码与对应节点，追踪临时变量的: Traverse expressions in post-order, breaking each operation into one three-address instruction. Highlight the source and the matching node, and trace where each temporary comes from.
先处理孩子，再产生当前指令: Handle the children first, then emit the current instruction
对二元表达式，先生成左、右子表达式的代码，再用一个临时变量保存本次运算结果。例如: For a binary expression, first generate code for the left and right subexpressions, then keep this operation’s result in a temporary. The result t0 of a multiplication, for example, becomes an input to the addition that follows.
三地址不是三条指令: Three-address does not mean three instructions
一条典型的三地址指令具有一个写入位置和最多两个输入，如 t1 = v0_x +: A typical three-address instruction has one destination and at most two inputs, as in t1 = v0_x + t0. Declarations and assignments produce copy instructions, and print is an observable output operation.
IR 是编译阶段之间的接口: IR is the interface between compiler stages
表达式树适合表达结构，线性指令便于逐条执行和分析。真实编译器可能使用多种抽象层次: Expression trees are good at expressing structure; linear instructions are easy to execute and analyze one by one. Real compilers may use IRs at several levels of abstraction; this uses a single, branch-free teaching format so the whole translation is visible.
IR 没有统一的唯一格式；这里的文本不是 LLVM IR，也不是某种真实 CPU: There is no single standard IR format; this text is neither LLVM IR nor the assembly of any real CPU.
三地址代码支持条件跳转与回边，控制流图见第 07 个实验；尚无 SSA、φ 节点: Three-address code supports conditional jumps and back edges — see lab 07 for the control-flow graph; there is no SSA, φ, register allocation or machine-code generation yet.
为 int result = 2 + 3 * 4; 写出未优化的三地址代码，解释: Write unoptimized three-address code for int result = 2 + 3 * 4;, and explain why t0 appears before t1.
t0 = 3 * 4；t1 = 2 + t0；v0_result = t1。乘法: t0 = 3 * 4; t1 = 2 + t0; v0_result = t1. The addition depends on the multiplication, whose result must come first.
为什么内部变量名要包含声明的独立编号？: Why do internal variable names include each declaration’s own number?
让变量都变成常量: To turn every variable into a constant
区别不同作用域中的同名声明: To tell apart same-named declarations in different scopes
作用域退出后，IR 仍需准确表达每次引用原本绑定的声明。: After a scope ends, the IR must still say exactly which declaration each reference was bound to.
少算几步，结果还能一样吗？: With fewer steps, is the result still the same?
独立开关常量传播、常量折叠与无用写入清理。比较前后指令，并实际执行两版程序验证输: Toggle constant propagation, constant folding and useless-write cleanup independently. Compare the instructions before and after, and run both programs to verify the output.
传播把已知常量替换到使用位置，折叠把合法常量算术提前算出。直线代码可以顺序扫描；: Propagation substitutes known constants at their uses; folding computes valid constant arithmetic ahead of time. Straight-line code can be scanned in order; with branches and loops, first merge predecessors and iterate to a fixed point, then rewrite with the stable facts. Every assignment to a mutable variable updates or clears the old information.
清理从 print 和可能报错的算术操作出发，逆向追踪它们需要哪些值。若一个复制: Cleanup starts from print and from arithmetic that may fail, tracing backward which values they need. If the value written by a copy is never used later, the copy can be deleted; if its input is still needed, the dependence stays.
未被使用的除法也可能除零；算术还可能超出安全整数范围。本实现保守保留未折叠的算术: An unused division can still divide by zero, and arithmetic can exceed the safe integer range. This implementation conservatively keeps unfolded arithmetic, so cleanup never swallows an error. Comparing the two runs is a clue for checking, not a general proof of correctness.
指令更少并不等于实测运行更快。本页统计指令条数，没有进行 CPU 性能测试。: Fewer instructions do not mean measurably faster execution. This page counts instructions; it does no CPU performance testing.
支持直线代码与基于 CFG 的常量传播、分支简化和活跃性清理；没有 SSA、范围: Supports constant propagation on straight-line code and over the CFG, branch simplification and liveness-based cleanup; no SSA, range analysis, floating-point reordering, CSE or loop unrolling.
关闭常量传播后，为什么有些折叠消失了？再试试 int unused = 1 /: With constant propagation off, why do some folds disappear? Then try int unused = 1 / 0; and explain why it must stay.
未传播的变量引用不是字面量，折叠无法直接求值。除零会产生可观察错误，即使 unu: An unpropagated variable reference is not a literal, so folding cannot evaluate it directly. Division by zero produces an observable error; even if unused is never read, the operation cannot be deleted.
已知 x = 2 后又执行 x = 5，下一次 print(x) 应传播什么？: x = 2 is known, then x = 5 runs. What should the next print(x) propagate?
顺序扫描必须更新 x 的常量信息，不能使用过期的 2。: A sequential scan must update x’s constant information and not use the stale 2.
没有寄存器，也能执行程序吗？: Can a program run without registers?
把三地址代码降为教学字节码，观察程序计数器、操作数栈、局部变量表和输出如何一起变: Lower three-address code into teaching bytecode and watch the program counter, the operand stack, the local-variable table and the output change together.
PUSH 把常量压栈，LOAD 读取局部变量并压栈。算术指令从栈顶取出两个操作数: PUSH pushes a constant, and LOAD reads a local variable and pushes it. Arithmetic instructions pop two operands off the top of the stack, compute, and push the result back; STORE writes the top of the stack into a local variable.
弹出顺序影响减法与除法: Pop order matters for subtraction and division
先压左项，再压右项，意味着右项在栈顶。执行 SUB 或 DIV 时必须先弹出右项: Pushing the left operand first and then the right means the right operand is on top. SUB or DIV must pop the right operand first, then the left. Reversing that order changes the result of non-commutative operations.
程序状态不止一个栈: Program state is more than one stack
PC 标明下一条要执行的指令。局部变量表保存已经 STORE 的值，print: The PC marks the next instruction to execute. The local-variable table holds values already STOREd, and print output is part of the state too. The replay shows a snapshot after each instruction, so you can step back to an earlier state exactly.
这里的操作数栈不是函数调用栈；本实验还没有函数调用、栈帧或递归。: This operand stack is not the function call stack; this lab has no function calls, stack frames or recursion yet.
自定义教学字节码，由浏览器内解释器执行；不是 CPython、JVM 字节码，也: Custom teaching bytecode executed by an in-browser interpreter; it is not CPython or JVM bytecode, and there is no real machine code.
只看栈状态，手动执行 PUSH 10、PUSH 3、SUB，解释为什么最后留下: Looking only at the stack state, execute PUSH 10, PUSH 3, SUB by hand and explain why 7 is left.
栈底是 10，栈顶是 3。SUB 依次取出 right = 3、left = 1: The bottom of the stack is 10 and the top is 3. SUB pops right = 3 then left = 10, computes left - right, and pushes 7.
执行 STORE v0_x 后，操作数栈通常会怎样变化？: After STORE v0_x, how does the operand stack usually change?
STORE 弹出栈顶的值，把它存进指定局部变量；栈高减一。: STORE pops the top value and stores it in the given local variable; the stack height drops by one.
程序为什么会走向另一条路？: Why does a program take a different path?
修改 if 条件与 while 循环次数，逐块回放控制流图。观察真正经过的边、每: Change the if condition and the number of while iterations, and replay the control-flow graph block by block. Watch the edges actually taken, the variables updated in each round, and where the program merges or exits.
基本块：连续执行的一小段代码: Basic blocks: small runs of code executed in a row
基本块只有一个入口，跳转发生在块的末尾。先把 IR 的开头、标签位置、跳转后的指: A basic block has a single entry, and jumps happen only at its end. First mark the start of the IR, label positions and instructions after jumps as leaders, then split into basic blocks. The boxes in the graph are these blocks; the lines show the allowed next steps. Labels and jump targets come from the instructions actually generated.
分支汇合，循环回到条件: Branches merge, loops return to the condition
if 的条件为 bool，运行时只进入真或假路径，随后汇合。while 先检查条: An if condition is a bool; at run time only the true or the false path is taken, and they merge afterwards. while checks its condition first, enters the body when it is true, and goes back along the back edge to check again; when it is false it exits. The graph contains every possible edge; the replay highlights only the one actually chosen this time.
点击图中的块可检查完整 IR 和后继边；播放时看到执行后的变量与输出快照。循环会: Click a block in the graph to inspect its full IR and successor edges; during playback you see snapshots of variables and output after execution. A loop passes through the same blocks repeatedly, but the variable state may differ each time. A block not visited yet is not necessarily unreachable forever.
不能把某条分支里算出的常量直接传播到汇合后的代码。第 08 个实验会保守合并所有: A constant computed in one branch cannot be propagated straight into the code after the merge. Lab 08 conservatively merges the facts of all predecessors that may execute; SSA and φ are still not implemented here.
支持 if / else、while、比较与嵌套块，主体必须用花括号；没有 br: Supports if / else, while, comparisons and nested blocks, with bodies in braces; no break / continue, short-circuit logic, functions or SSA. At most 2000 bytecode instructions per run; reaching the limit only pauses this replay.
先预测循环累加预设的输出。说明循环条件为什么比循环体多执行一次；把 i < 4: First predict the output of the loop-sum preset. Explain why the loop condition runs once more than the body; after changing i < 4 to i <= 4, which edges are taken and how does the output change?
i 从 1 开始，i < 4 执行 3 轮，sum 为 1 + 2 + 3 =: i starts at 1, so i < 4 runs 3 rounds and sum is 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. One more check at i = 4 is needed to take the false exit edge, so the condition is checked 4 times. With <= it runs 4 rounds, prints 10, and checks the condition 5 times.
while 的条件第一次就是 false 时，循环体会执行几次？: When a while condition is false the very first time, how many times does the body run?
while 先判断条件，为 false 就直接走退出边；循环体可以一次都不执行。: while checks the condition first and takes the exit edge directly when it is false; the body may not run at all.
跨过分支，还能确定一个常量吗？: Across a branch, can a constant still be determined?
逐轮合并各基本块的 IN / OUT，观察循环如何让事实变化、两条路径怎样汇合，: Merge the IN / OUT of each basic block round by round, and watch how loops change the facts and how two paths merge, until a fixed point is reached. Then use the static reasoning for real cross-block optimization.
合并事实，需要同时考虑多条路径: Merging facts means considering several paths at once
本实验用三层信息表示变量：⊥ 是尚无信息，常量 c 表示确定的值，⊤ 表示不能确: This lab describes variables with three levels: ⊥ is no information yet, a constant c is a definite value, and ⊤ means no single constant can be determined. If both predecessors give 7, the merge is still 7; if they give 7 and 9, the merge is ⊤. bool true and the integer 1 are not the same constant either.
循环要求反复传播到不动点: Loops require propagating repeatedly to a fixed point
先从入口出发，合并当前可能执行的边传来的 OUT，再顺序处理本块指令。常量条件只: Start from the entry, merge the OUT arriving over edges that may currently execute, then process the block’s instructions in order. A constant condition enables only one edge, an unknown condition conservatively enables both; enabled does not mean the path has been proven feasible. Adding a back edge may overturn an earlier constant; blocks are processed again until neither facts nor edges change. No result from this VM run is borrowed here.
向后求活跃性，再删除无用写入: Compute liveness backward, then delete useless writes
变量的当前值若可能沿后续路径被读取，它就是活跃的。各块的 OUT 合并后继 IN: A variable’s current value is live if it may be read along some later path. Each block’s OUT merges its successors’ IN, and IN adds the block’s uses and removes its definitions. The optimizer solves again on the rewritten CFG and cleans up useless copies; unfolded arithmetic is kept so as not to swallow division by zero or overflow.
循环实际跑完后 i 等于 2，不代表常量分析一定能证明它等于 2。这个有限分析域: That i equals 2 after the loop actually finishes does not mean constant analysis can prove it is 2. This finite analysis domain does not track value ranges or iteration counts; ⊤ is a conservative conclusion, not a computation error.
可变变量上的稠密条件常量传播与活跃性分析；不是 LLVM 的稀疏 SSA 实现。: Dense conditional constant propagation and liveness analysis on mutable variables; not LLVM’s sparse SSA implementation. At most 200 rounds; without convergence the original IR is kept. The intermediate replay records at most 240 block visits, and the last step still shows the complete result. No range analysis, SSA or general proof of equivalence.
运行“两条路径相同常量”，找到汇合后的 value。把 else 中的 7 改成: Run “Same constant on both paths” and find value after the merge. Change the 7 in else to 9, and explain why the static fact becomes ⊤ while this run’s actual output may still be 7.
循环让 i 的常量事实变成 ⊤，分析必须考虑 if 的两条路径。两边都赋 7 时: The loop turns the constant fact for i into ⊤, so the analysis must consider both paths of the if. When both sides assign 7, value merges to 7; once one side becomes 9, no single value can be picked, and the merge must be ⊤. The VM taking the true branch and printing 7 is just one execution and cannot replace a static proof.
两个可执行前驱分别给 x = 7 与 x = 9，汇合点的常量事实是什么？: Two executable predecessors give x = 7 and x = 9. What is the constant fact at the merge point?
⊤：无法确定唯一常量: ⊤: no single constant can be determined
任一前驱都可能到达；没有额外证明时必须保留两种可能，不能只取一次运行的值。: Either predecessor may arrive; without further proof both possibilities must be kept, and the value from one run cannot be taken.
控制流 · 两条分支在哪里汇合: Control flow · where two branches merge
把 score 从 75 改成 40，哪条边会改变？两条路径在哪里汇合？: Change score from 75 to 40 — which edge changes? Where do the two paths merge?
控制流 · 循环累加与回边: Control flow · loop sum and back edge
输出是 6 还是 10？条件检查次数与循环体执行次数一样吗？: Is the output 6 or 10? Is the condition checked as many times as the body runs?
对照 · 循环体一次都不执行: Contrast · the loop body never runs
图中存在的循环体，这次运行一定会经过吗？: The loop body exists in the graph — is it necessarily visited in this run?
控制流 · 循环里的分支: Control flow · a branch inside a loop
同一个 if 基本块，不同轮次会选择相同的边吗？: Does the same if block choose the same edge in every round?
对照 · 没有执行的除零: Contrast · a division by zero that never runs
语义合法的除零位于未选中的分支，本次运行会报错吗？: A semantically valid division by zero sits in the branch not taken. Does this run raise an error?
回放边界 · 忘记更新循环变量: Replay limits · forgetting to update the loop variable
条件一直为真时会怎样？回放上限能否证明程序永远不终止？: What happens when the condition stays true? Can the replay limit prove that the program never terminates?
数据流 · 两条路径相同常量: Data flow · same constant on both paths
分析不能确定循环结束时的 i，但两个分支都给出 7。value 在汇合后还是常量: The analysis cannot determine i at the end of the loop, but both branches give 7. Is value still a constant after the merge?
数据流 · 两条路径不同常量: Data flow · different constants on the two paths
本次输出还是 7，静态分析为什么不能直接传播 7？: This run still prints 7. Why can’t static analysis simply propagate 7?
数据流 · 证明分支不可达: Data flow · proving a branch unreachable
ready 已知为 false，哪一条边能被证明不可执行？除零可以随该分支一起删: ready is known to be false. Which edge can be proven never to execute? Can the division by zero be deleted along with that branch?
数据流 · 回边改变早期事实: Data flow · a back edge changes early facts
回边合并后，i 与 fixed 的常量事实会一起消失吗？: After the back edge is merged, do the constant facts for i and fixed both disappear?
数据流 · 跨边界的活跃变量: Data flow · live variables across boundaries
关闭常量传播后，value 的写入还能删除吗？dead 与 i 呢？: With constant propagation off, can the write to value still be deleted? What about dead and i?
先预测：输出是 14，还是 20？: Predict first: is the output 14 or 20?
括号 · 改写运算顺序: Parentheses · changing the order of operations
只加了一对括号，AST 的根会变化吗？: Only one pair of parentheses was added. Does the root of the AST change?
integer 会成为一个 Token，还是两个？: Does integer become one Token or two?
作用域 · 同名变量: Scope · variables with the same name
两次输出是否一样？内部的 x 会修改外层吗？: Are the two outputs the same? Does the inner x change the outer one?
x 被修改后，优化器会使用哪个常量？: After x is changed, which constant does the optimizer use?
哪一个阶段会首先发现错误？: Which stage finds the error first?
语法树能成功构建吗？: Can the syntax tree be built?
解析器在哪个 Token 处发现了问题？: At which Token does the parser find the problem?
优化边界 · 无用的除零: Optimization limits · a useless division by zero
变量未被使用，除零指令能直接删掉吗？: The variable is never used. Can the division-by-zero instruction simply be deleted?
不先猜整棵树，能不能先拼小块，再拼成大树？: Instead of guessing the whole tree first, can we assemble small pieces and then the big tree?
实验 11 的 LL 从树根往下猜，左递归文法只能先改写。这里换个方向：先把 T: The LL of lab 11 guesses downward from the root, so left-recursive grammars have to be rewritten first. Here the direction is reversed: put Tokens into a workspace first, and once they make up the right side of a production, combine them into the name on its left. The book’s left-recursive grammar parses without rewriting.
先回到实验 11：LL 是从上往下猜: Back to lab 11 first: LL guesses from the top down
LL 解析一开始就站在树根，每一步都要先决定“用哪条产生式往下展开”。所以它必须: LL parsing starts at the root of the tree, and every step must first decide “which production to expand with”. So it must pick right at a glance, and on left recursion such as add -> add + mul it can only rewrite the grammar first. This page goes the other way: don’t decide yet; wait until enough Tokens have been seen.
换个方向：先拼小块，再拼大块: The other direction: small pieces first, then big ones
想象拼图：手边有一个工作区（栈）。从左往右读 Token，先放进工作区；当工作区: Think of a jigsaw puzzle with a workspace (a stack) at hand. Read Tokens from left to right and put them into the workspace; when the rightmost few pieces exactly form the right side of some production, combine them into one piece named by its left side. The pieces get bigger and bigger until only the start symbol is left, and the whole tree is assembled.
工作区 还没读 动作\n:
workspace         unread         action
                  2 + 3 * 5 $    shift 2
Num               + 3 * 5 $      reduce pri -> Num
pri               + 3 * 5 $      reduce mul -> pri
mul               + 3 * 5 $      reduce add -> mul
add               + 3 * 5 $      shift +
只有两个动作：移进和规约: Only two actions: shift and reduce
“移进”就是读一个 Token 放进工作区；“规约”就是把工作区顶上的几块，按某: “Shift” reads one Token into the workspace; “reduce” combines the top few pieces of the workspace into the name on the left of some production. Read backward, the order of reductions is exactly the derivation that “always expands the rightmost name”, called the rightmost derivation. The L in LR means reading left to right, and the R means rightmost derivation.
难点：什么时候该规约？: The hard part: when to reduce?
读到 2 + 3 时，工作区是 add + mul，正好是 add -> add: After reading 2 + 3, the workspace is add + mul, exactly the right side of add -> add + mul. But if the next Token is *, combining into add now would be wrong: multiplication comes first, so wait until 3 * 5 forms one mul. The workspace alone is not enough; you also need to know “where you are in which production”, combined with the next Token.
add + mul 下一个是 * → 先别规约，继续移进\nadd:
add + mul      next is *  → don’t reduce yet, keep shifting
add + mul      next is $  → can reduce to add
用一个点记住进度：项目: Track progress with a dot: items
在产生式右边加一个点，表示“读到哪了”。add -> add · + mul 的: Put a dot into the right side of a production to show “how far reading has got”. add -> add · + mul means: an add has been recognized and a + is expected. When the dot reaches the end, as in add -> add + mul ·, the right side is complete and a reduction can be considered. Such a dotted production is called an “item”.
add -> · add + mul 还什么都没认出\nadd -> ad:
add -> · add + mul    nothing recognized yet
add -> add · + mul    add recognized, waiting for +
add -> add + mul ·    all recognized, can reduce
读到某处时，自己可能处在好几条产生式的不同位置上。和实验 10 的子集构造一样，: At some point in the input you may be at different positions in several productions. As with the subset construction of lab 10, don’t pick one: put all possible items together as one state. If the dot is followed by a name, as in add -> · mul, then mul may start being recognized next, so mul -> · pri and the like are added too. This is computing the closure, the counterpart of lab 10’s ε-closure.
状态之间按符号转移，填成两张表: States move by symbols and fill two tables
在一个状态里，把点后面是 X 的项目都往后挪一格，就得到读入 X 之后的新状态。: In a state, moving the dot one step past X in every item where X follows the dot gives the new state after reading X. All the states and transitions form an automaton. The ACTION table says whether, in a given state on a given Token, to shift, reduce or accept; the GOTO table says which state to go to after reducing to a name. This lab uses the SLR(1) rule: with the dot at the end, reduce only if the next Token is in the FOLLOW of that name, the same set computed in lab 11.
表里塞进两个动作，也是冲突: Two actions in one cell is also a conflict
如果某个格子既能移进又能规约，叫移进/规约冲突；既能按这条又能按那条规约，叫规约: If a cell allows both shift and reduce, that is a shift/reduce conflict; if it allows reducing by two different productions, a reduce/reduce conflict. An ambiguous grammar like e -> e + e can build 2 + 3 + 4 into two different trees and produces a conflict. LR is stronger than LL: for lab 11’s grammars that “start the same way”, it can shift first and decide later. But the book also mentions its drawback: until assembly is finished, the shape of the whole tree is unknown, so an error is hard to place within the whole.
从左往右读 Token。移进：把 Token 压进工作区（栈）。规约：栈顶几项正: Read Tokens from left to right. Shift: push a Token into the workspace (stack). Reduce: when the top few items are exactly the right side of a production, combine them into the name on its left. When only the start symbol is left on the stack and the input is used up, accept. The order of reductions, reversed, is the rightmost derivation.
带点的产生式叫项目，点表示读到哪里。一个状态是一组项目；点后面是非终结符时，把它: A production with a dot is an item, and the dot shows how far reading has got. A state is a set of items; when a nonterminal follows the dot, its productions (dot at the front) are added, which is the closure. Moving the dot one step in all items where X follows it gives the state after reading X. All the states form a DFA.
点后面是 Token：移进；点在末尾：下一个 Token 在 FOLLOW(左边: A Token after the dot: shift; the dot at the end: reduce when the next Token is in FOLLOW(left side) (SLR); S′ → start symbol · on $: accept. After a reduction, the GOTO table gives the new state. Two actions in one cell are a shift/reduce or reduce/reduce conflict.
“栈顶凑齐一条产生式的右边就马上规约”是错的。add + mul 后面如果跟着: “Reduce as soon as the top of the stack forms a production’s right side” is wrong. If add + mul is followed by *, you must shift first so that 3 * 5 forms mul. The decision rests on “current state + next Token”, not just on what the top of the stack looks like.
LR(0) 项目集 + SLR(1) 分析表与移进 / 规约解析；复用实验 11: LR(0) item sets + an SLR(1) parse table and shift / reduce parsing; reuses lab 11’s grammar notation and FIRST / FOLLOW. The book’s example says LR(1); this lab uses the simpler SLR(1): some grammars have no conflict under LR(1) but do under SLR(1), e.g. S -> L = R | R, L -> * R | Id, R -> L. No full LR(1) / LALR, no error recovery and no precedence-based conflict resolution. At most 80 states and a parse replay of at most 600 steps; no parse is done when there are conflicts.
用“原书的例子”预设走到读入 3 之后。说出栈里有什么、为什么遇到 * 时移进而: With the “Book example” preset, go to just after 3 is read. Say what is on the stack and why it shifts on * instead of reducing to add. Then give the first three lines of the rightmost derivation and how they relate to the order of reductions.
此时栈里是 add + mul（中间夹着各自的状态号）。所在状态里既有完整的 a: The stack now holds add + mul (with their state numbers in between). The current state contains both the complete add → add + mul · and mul → mul · * pri; SLR reduces only when the next Token is in FOLLOW(add), and * is not, so it shifts * to let 3 * 5 form mul first. The rightmost derivation starts start ⇒ add ⇒ add + mul ⇒ add + mul * pri, exactly the reductions of the parse read backward.
为什么 LR 能直接处理 add -> add + mul 这样的左递归？: Why can LR handle left recursion like add -> add + mul directly?
它会自动把文法改写成右递归: It rewrites the grammar into right recursion automatically
它先移进，等右边凑齐了才规约，不需要一开始就决定展开哪条产生式: It shifts first and reduces only once the right side is complete, so it never has to decide up front which production to expand
左递归只让“先展开再说”的自顶向下算法陷入无限下降。LR 自底向上，看见 add: Left recursion only makes “expand first, ask later” top-down algorithms descend forever. LR works bottom-up and decides to combine into add only once add + mul is on the stack, so it never recurses forever.

Two different sets only show that construction took different paths; which suffixes they accept from now on may still be exactly the same. For ab|cb, for example, after reading a or c only b needs to be read next.
只判断一种语言时，可以先分接受与拒绝。词法扫描器还要保留 Token 类别，因此: When deciding a single language, you can start with accept vs. reject. A lexical scanner must also keep Token categories, so this lab groups by winning rule number: a state accepting A and one accepting B cannot merge even though both accept. Rule order and skip behavior are already contained in the winning rule.
再问：读同一个字符，会去同一组吗？: Next ask: on the same character, do they go to the same group?
比较同组状态对每类字符的后继组编号，这串编号叫签名。签名不同，就把这一组拆开。新: Compare, for states in one group, the successor group numbers for each character class; this string of numbers is the signature. Different signatures split the group. New groups may in turn make other groups’ signatures differ, so checking must repeat; only when nothing can be split any more are the groups stable.

D1 reads b → group that accepts Tok
D0 reads b → reject group
so D1 and D0 cannot be in the same group.

原始图省略了失败边。细化时先把缺失转换补到拒绝状态 Dead，再让它对每个字符回: The original graph omits failure edges. Before refining, missing transitions are completed to a rejecting state Dead, which loops back to itself on every character. If Dead is unreachable from the entry, it is not added. The final scanner keeps omitting the Dead class and edges into it; state counts say whether this completion state is included.
用一段后缀证明不能合并: Prove that two states cannot merge with a suffix
从两个状态同时出发，广度优先搜索状态对；一旦到达不同的输出，就找到了区分后缀。第: Start from both states at once and search state pairs breadth-first; as soon as the outputs differ, a distinguishing suffix is found. The first one found is the shortest counterexample. If the rules already differ without reading another character, the counterexample is the empty string ε. Only when all state pairs are exhausted without a counterexample are they equivalent.
最后检查合并有没有改坏扫描器: Finally, check that merging did not break the scanner
每个稳定组成为一个新状态。程序独立搜索原始与最小化机器的状态积，校验全部后缀的获: Each stable group becomes one new state. The program independently searches the product of the original and minimized machines, checks the winning rule for every suffix, then actually scans the current input and compares Token categories, lexemes, start and end positions, skips and the first failure position. Back-up counts and state numbers are replay details, not Token semantics.
两个状态在当前输入上碰巧得到相同结果，不足以合并。它们必须对所有支持的后缀得到相: Two states that happen to give the same result on the current input are not enough to merge. They must give the same winning rule, or both reject, for every supported suffix. A distinguishing suffix may be found from states the current example input never reaches.
分组要同时尊重输出和转换: Grouping must respect both outputs and transitions
先按获胜规则分组，再用后继所在组细化到不动点。这里使用便于逐步观察的 Moore: Group by winning rule first, then refine by successor groups to a fixed point. This uses Moore-style partition refinement, easy to watch step by step, not Hopcroft’s worklist algorithm; no claim is made about Hopcroft’s time complexity. Unreachable states are removed first.
状态变少不等于每个字符少走一步: Fewer states do not mean fewer steps per character
原始与最小化机器都逐字符查转换表，合并主要减少状态和表格。最长匹配仍需记录最后接: Both the original and the minimized machine look up the transition table once per character; merging mainly reduces states and table size. The longest match still has to record the last accepting position and may back up; same-length contests between keywords and identifiers are still decided by the original rule order.
不能把所有接受状态合并，也不能只看一跳后继是否相同。接受不同 Token 的状态: You cannot merge every accepting state, nor look only at whether the one-step successors match. States accepting different Tokens must stay apart, and candidates that match after one step may still be told apart by a longer suffix. Minimization does not undo the state explosion that already happened during subset construction either.
复用实验 10 的规则解析、Thompson 构造、子集构造和最长匹配扫描。对完: Reuses lab 10’s rule parsing, Thompson construction, subset construction and longest-match scanning. Partition refinement by winning rule is done on the complete, entry-reachable DFA; only the stable groups of the complete machine including a reachable implicit Dead count for minimality. Export omits the Dead class, and an empty language still keeps its entry. The alphabet is limited to printable ASCII and \t \n \r; at most 8 rules of 80 characters each, 300 input characters and 64 DFA states (completion adds at most one Dead). If construction exceeds a limit, no minimization or scan result is published. No Hopcroft, Unicode or NFA minimization, and the number of states is not guaranteed to drop.
先选“相同后缀可以合并”，查询 D1 与 D2，再查询 D0 与 D1，解释为什: First choose “Same suffixes can merge”, query D1 vs. D2, then D0 vs. D1, and explain why the latter pair cannot merge. Then choose “Different Tokens cannot merge” and explain why two end states that both accept must stay apart.
ab|cb 读过 a 或 c 后的状态接受相同的后缀 b，所以可合并。入口与读过: In ab|cb, the states after reading a or c accept the same suffix b, so they can merge. The entry and the state after a, however, are told apart by b: the latter accepts Tok, the former rejects. The two end states of rules A: ab and B: cb output A and B, so the empty string ε already distinguishes them, and they cannot merge.
两个状态都能接受，是否就能合并？: If two states both accept, can they be merged?
能，只要都接受: Yes, as long as both accept
不能，还要比较获胜规则与所有后缀的行为: No, the winning rule and the behavior on every suffix must also be compared
能，只要这次输入的 Token 相同: Yes, as long as this input gives the same Tokens
词法 DFA 的输出包含规则编号；规则不同，空串就能区分它们。即使当前输出相同，: The output of a lexical DFA includes the rule number; with different rules, the empty string already tells them apart. Even if the current outputs agree, the behavior of suffix transitions must still be checked.

接着静态单赋值实验，按前驱边把 φ 变成复制，拆分关键边、安排复制顺序，再生成普: Following the static single assignment lab, turn φ into copies per predecessor edge, split critical edges, schedule the copies, then generate ordinary bytecode for the original stack VM to run.
把每个 φ 的选择放回前驱边: Put each φ’s choice back onto the predecessor edge
实验 13 中，φ 按刚刚经过的前驱选择输入。消除 φ 时，把这个选择改成对应边: In lab 13, a φ picks its input according to the predecessor just passed. Eliminating φ turns that choice into ordinary copies on the corresponding edge. All φ at the top of a block entered by the same edge must first be combined into one parallel copy; they cannot be handled one by one while forgetting that they depend on each other.
先确定复制放在哪里: First decide where the copies go
前驱只有一条后继边时，可以在它的普通指令之后、跳转之前放复制。否则，若目标只有一: If the predecessor has only one outgoing edge, the copies can go after its ordinary instructions and before its jump. Otherwise, if the target has only one predecessor, they can go at the target’s entry. When neither holds, it is a critical edge: insert a new edge block so the copies run only when that edge is taken.
B0 → B2\n变为\nB0 → E0（复制）→ B2:
B0 → B2
becomes
B0 → E0 (copies) → B2

同时做 a ← b 和 b ← a 的意思是交换旧值。直接先写 a，再读 a 写: Doing a ← b and b ← a at the same time means swapping the old values. Writing a first and then reading a to write b makes both become the old b. A correct schedule first finds destinations that are safe to overwrite; when the copies form a cycle, a new temporary saves an old value.

原始标签是别名，新的输出为每个块分配明确标签。条件块分别跳到真、假目标，新边块执: The original labels are aliases; the new output gives every block an explicit label. The block order shown is not the execution order; every edge is connected through real labels and jumps, and exits jump to one shared HALT.
接回已有的字节码生成器和 VM: Hook back into the existing bytecode generator and VM
转换结果只包含普通的赋值、运算、输出、标签和跳转，没有 φ。页面比较原始 VM、: The result contains only ordinary assignments, operations, prints, labels and jumps — no φ. The page compares the output and errors of the original VM, the SSA interpreter and the VM after translation, and replays the real PC, operand stack and output of the VM after translation. The representations count steps and jumps differently, and if any of them hits a limit, no agreement is claimed.
φ 是边上的选择: φ is a choice on an edge
边复制的位置由实际前驱与后继关系决定。分支只走一边，不能因为两边最终都汇合，就把: Where an edge copy goes is decided by the actual predecessor and successor relations. A branch takes only one side; just because both sides merge eventually, one edge’s copies cannot be moved freely before the branch or after the merge. Splitting critical edges makes this execution location explicit.
先保留旧值，再覆盖位置: Keep the old value first, then overwrite the location
调度时，目标的旧值若仍是其他待处理复制的源，就暂时不能覆盖。找不到安全目标时，保: During scheduling, a destination cannot be overwritten yet if its old value is still the source of another pending copy. When no safe destination exists, save one old value in the cycle and redirect the corresponding reads. Self-copies can be omitted, and temporaries must use new names that clash with nothing.
消除表示不等于完成后端优化: Eliminating the representation is not finishing back-end optimization
这里实现的是保留独立版本位置的基础 SSA 消除，不做复制合并、寄存器分配或机器: This implements basic out-of-SSA translation that keeps separate version locations; it does no copy coalescing, register allocation or machine-code generation, and does not swap the existing optimizer for an SSA optimizer. The ordinary IR is handed to the original VM, and the teaching limits are still strict bool and safe integers.
“φ 的每个输入都复制一次”缺少两个条件：复制要出现在对应的控制流边上，同一条边: “Copy each φ input once” is missing two conditions: the copies must appear on the corresponding control-flow edges, and the group of copies on one edge must keep the semantics of reading all old values at once. Copying in list order may overwrite a value not yet read; putting copies on the wrong path can also change the loop state.
仅消除当前标量局部变量 SSA 的 φ，保留版本名。前驱末尾、后继入口或新边块放: Eliminates φ only for the current scalar SSA of locals, keeping version names. Copies are placed at the end of the predecessor, at the entry of the successor, or in a new edge block; copy cycles are scheduled before ordinary IR is rebuilt, reusing the existing bytecode generator and VM. No copy coalescing, register allocation, functions or machine-code back end. Programs of at most 2000 characters, at most 10000 translated IR instructions and 2000 VM bytecode instructions; the intermediate replays of construction and VM each keep the first 240 steps, and the final results are kept in full. If any execution exceeds a limit, only output prefixes are compared and the result is shown as undecidable. The copy mini lab is independent of the main program, with at most 500 characters, 12 copies and 24 initial names, and is not written into the share URL.
在默认预设中把 choose 从 false 改成 true，说明 E0 是否仍: In the default preset, change choose from false to true and say whether E0 still exists and whether this VM run passes through it. Then swap a and b in the copy mini lab and explain why naive sequential copying is wrong and what the temporary holds.
关键边来自原始 CFG 的结构，常量条件变化不删除它；E0 仍存在，但选择真分支: A critical edge comes from the structure of the original CFG, and changing a constant condition does not delete it; E0 still exists, but choosing the true branch never passes through the edge block of the false edge. A swap must read the two old values of a and b; writing a first destroys the later read. Only by first saving the old a in a temporary and writing b last does it achieve a parallel swap.
一组并行复制 a ← b、b ← a，初始 a=1、b=2。哪种顺序正确？: A parallel copy a ← b, b ← a with initial a=1, b=2. Which order is correct?

Common-subexpression elimination matches by name and operator (operands of commutative operations sorted) based on global available-expressions analysis; no partial redundancy elimination, global value numbering or algebraic simplification. Local value numbering is for comparison only and does not change the code. Loop hoisting only handles results with a single assignment and places them before the loop header; operations that may overflow or divide by zero are hoisted only from the loop-condition computation, and those in the loop body only when they cannot fail. Analysis runs at most 200 rounds and the replay keeps the first 240 steps; the VM runs at most 2000 bytecode instructions, and if any version exceeds a limit, no agreement is claimed.

Conversely, graph coloring and linear scan are both heuristics: on some programs graph coloring may spill more than linear scan, and neither guarantees the fewest loads / stores.
分配对象是未优化的原始三地址代码，让每个临时值和寄存器压力都可见；真实编译器通常: Allocation works on the unoptimized original three-address code, so every temporary and the register pressure stay visible; real compilers usually allocate on a low-level IR after optimization and instruction selection. K can be 2–8, all registers are interchangeable, and there are no calling conventions, precoloring, caller/callee saving or register classes. Graph coloring is Chaitin simplification + Briggs optimistic coloring, with spill cost “uses and definitions × 10^loop depth ÷ degree” (a heuristic chosen by this project); popping prefers the register of the other end of a copy, but there is no copy coalescing, live-range splitting, rematerialization or stack-slot reuse. Linear scan follows Poletto & Sarkar’s whole-interval approach, numbered in IR text order. The register machine is a teaching format, not x86 or ARM instructions, and no machine code is generated. Programs of at most 2000 characters, at most 16 rounds of spill rewriting, 10000 IR instructions and 2000 register-machine instructions; allocation and execution replays each keep the first 240 steps, and the final result is complete.

The book’s list scheduling is this family of algorithms.

寄存器少时，同一个 r0 被一个接一个的值复用，反依赖和输出依赖把指令串成一条链: With few registers, the same r0 is reused by one value after another; anti and output dependences chain the instructions together, leaving little room for reordering, and spills bring more loads. The book notes that compilers usually schedule both before and after allocation. The final page lists the false dependences and cycle counts for each K so you can compare directly.
窥孔优化：只看相邻几条指令: Peephole optimization: look only at a few adjacent instructions
窥孔优化（Peephole optimization）用一个小窗口滑过代码，找能: Peephole optimization slides a small window over the code looking for fixed patterns to replace. The book’s example stores a register to the stack and immediately reads it back into the same register — that load is redundant. Spill code often produces such pairs. This page’s window is 2 wide; the rules are described alongside.
延迟决定空转，依赖决定能否移动: Latency decides stalls; dependences decide what can move
真依赖带着延迟：A 发出后要等若干周期 B 才能读。反依赖、输出依赖和顺序约束只: True dependences carry latency: after A issues, B can read only some cycles later. Anti dependences, output dependences and ordering constraints only require order, not waiting out latency (output dependences must also ensure the earlier write does not finish later). Reordering changes only the issue order, not what each instruction does.
排序是局部的，计时是全程的: Scheduling is local; timing is global
列表调度只在基本块内部移动指令，块与块之间不交换。执行时的周期数则来自整段程序的: List scheduling moves instructions only within a basic block, never between blocks. Cycle counts at run time, however, come from actually executing the whole program: the same timing model issues instruction after instruction, and waits across blocks count too. So per-block estimates and executed cycles may differ.
重排结果先经独立检查：任意两条读写同一寄存器或栈槽、或者都可观察的指令，先后顺序: The reordering first passes an independent check: any two instructions that read or write the same register or stack slot, or that are both observable, keep their order; then it runs on the register machine and is compared with the original VM for output and errors. Cycle counts come only from this page’s teaching pipeline model and do not represent any real CPU.
“重排只看数据从哪来”漏掉了两点：寄存器复用会产生反依赖和输出依赖，即使两条指令: “Reordering only has to look at where data comes from” misses two things: register reuse creates anti and output dependences, so two instructions cannot be swapped even if they handle different values; and an instruction that may fail, if moved past a print, changes the output before the error. Also, fewer cycles do not mean every program gets faster; without independent instructions to fill in, stalls cannot be removed.
输入是实验 17 在未优化三地址代码上的分配结果，沿用同一组 K 与算法设置。只: The input is lab 17’s allocation of the unoptimized three-address code, using the same K and algorithm settings. List scheduling is done only within basic blocks; no cross-block scheduling, loop unrolling, software pipelining or register renaming. The pipeline is a teaching model: single issue, in order, no branch penalty, no caches or out-of-order execution; load and multiplication take 3 cycles, division 4, everything else 1. The peephole window is 2 wide, and its only rules are redundant load, store forwarded as a copy, two stores in a row, jump to the next instruction and self-copy. print and arithmetic that may overflow or divide by zero keep their relative order within a block — this project’s precise-exception convention; in C, signed overflow is undefined behavior and real compilers have different constraints. No machine code is generated. The scheduling and peephole replay keeps the first 240 steps, execution is limited to 2000 instructions, and if any execution exceeds a limit, the result is shown as undecidable.

唯一命名还不够：普通使用必须由定义支配，φ 的输入必须覆盖可达前驱，且定义能到达: Unique names are not enough: ordinary uses must be dominated by their definitions, φ inputs must cover the reachable predecessors, and each definition must reach the end of its predecessor. SSA 是一种表示，不会自动变快: SSA is a representation and does not make things faster by itself
每个静态版本只定义一次，使定义与使用的关系更清楚。插入 φ 和重命名本身没有消除: Each static version is defined only once, which makes the relation between definitions and uses clearer. Inserting φ and renaming do not remove any computation themselves, and version or instruction counts cannot stand in for performance measurement. 活跃性决定哪些候选值得保留: Liveness decides which candidates are worth keeping
从定义块沿支配边界迭代；只在变量入口活跃的块插入 φ，并把新 φ 当成定义继续传: Iterate from the defining blocks along dominance frontiers; insert φ only in blocks where the variable is live at entry, and treat each new φ as a definition to propagate further. The candidate table also lists pruned positions. A temporary defined and then used inside the loop body usually needs no merge at the loop header.

普通使用的定义应在同块更早的位置，或在支配它的块中。φ 的输入则在前驱末尾检查：: The definition for an ordinary use should be earlier in the same block or in a block that dominates it. φ inputs, however, are checked at the end of the predecessor: the update definition on a back edge need not dominate the loop header, but it must dominate the source of that back edge. Several φ assign logically at the same time.
φ 不会执行所有分支，也不会求和或任选一个值。改变条件会改变本次选中的输入，但不: φ does not execute every branch, nor does it add values or pick one at random. Changing a condition changes the input chosen this time, but does not delete the other structural edge of the original CFG. Static single assignment also does not mean a definition in a loop can execute only once at run time.
